article.title: Conector -길래
article.part: Conectores y modalidad avanzada — 고급 연결과 양태
article.chapter: Conectores complejos C1 — 고급 연결 어미

claims.sectionKey: La terminación conectiva **-길래** presenta una circunstancia que el hablante percibió, observó o tomó como motivo para realizar la acción de la cláusula siguient
claims.summary: The connector -길래 indicates a circumstance perceived, observed, or taken as a reason by the speaker to perform the action in the following clause.

claims.sectionKey: Su valor no es simplemente causal: la primera cláusula funciona como la razón que explica por qué el hablante actuó, decidió o reaccionó de cierta manera.
claims.summary: The value of -길래 is not merely causal; it functions as a reason explaining why the speaker acted, decided, or reacted in a certain way.

claims.sectionKey: En **밖에 비가 오길래 우산을 가져왔다** —«Como vi que estaba lloviendo afuera, traje un paraguas»— la lluvia es la circunstancia observada que explica la acción de traer el p
claims.summary: In the example '밖에 비가 오길래 우산을 가져왔다' (Like I saw it was raining outside, I brought an umbrella), the rain is the observed circumstance that explains the action of bringing the umbrella.

claims.sectionKey: En **사람들이 줄을 서 있길래 나도 기다렸다.** — Como vi que la gente estaba haciendo fila, yo también esperé.
claims.summary: In the example '사람들이 줄을 서 있길래 나도 기다렸다' (Like I saw people lining up, I also waited), the observed circumstance (people lining up) motivates the speaker's action (waiting).

claims.sectionKey: En **전화가 계속 오길래 무슨 일인지 확인했다.** — Como seguían entrando llamadas, comprobé qué pasaba.
claims.summary: In the example '전화가 계속 오길래 무슨 일인지 확인했다' (Like calls were continuously coming in, I checked what was happening), the repeated calls are the observed circumstance that prompts the speaker's action (checking).

links.notes: The source from the National Institute of Korean Language (국립국어원) provides a clear definition of -길래 as a connector indicating a perceived circumstance that motivates the action in the following clause.

The same source from the National Institute of Korean Language (국립국어원) explains that -길래 serves as a reason explaining the speaker's action, decision, or reaction, distinguishing it from causal connectors like -기에.

The example directly illustrates the use of -길래 to express a perceived circumstance (the rain) that motivates an action (bringing an umbrella), aligning with the historical claim about the connector's function.
This example further demonstrates the use of -길래 to connect an observed circumstance (people lining up) with the speaker's subsequent action (waiting), reinforcing the historical claim.
This example illustrates how -길래 connects an observed circumstance (continuous calls) with the speaker's action (checking), supporting the historical claim about the connector's usage.
